description: This file defines configuration utilities for setting up camera sessions in an app, including adding inputs and outputs such as camera, photo, microphone, and movie file outputs. It also declares related error enums.

methods.name: addCameraInput
methods.description: Adds a camera input to the provided AVCaptureSession, throwing an error if the input cannot be added.

methods.name: addPhotoOutput
methods.description: Creates and adds a photo output to the session, configuring its quality priority, and throws an error if unable.

methods.name: addMovieOutput
methods.description: Sets up and adds a movie file output to the session, optionally including audio input and setting the recording duration.
